headings.title: Court clerk collection of statutory costs
headings.reviewNote: Requires court clerks to collect all statutory court costs beginning July 1, 1997.

headings.title: Supreme court authority to set court costs
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes supreme court to set court cost amounts to generate authorized statutory revenues.

headings.title: Statutory base fee and charge schedule
headings.reviewNote: Establishes baseline schedule of civil, criminal, and probate filing fees prior to supreme court adjustment.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on court clerk collection of statutory costs beginning July 1, 1997, supreme court fee-setting limits, and the 23-item pre-adjustment statutory base fee schedule.

headings.title: Deposit of collected costs into court funds
headings.reviewNote: Governs clerk disbursement of collected court costs under supreme court rule beginning July 1, 2000, including OSCA special trust funds and investment rules.

headings.title: State courts administrator disbursement of funds
headings.reviewNote: Directs OSCA disbursement within thirty days of receipt for refunds, reimbursements, specific charges, 80%/20% state/county remainder split, and 60%/40% interest revolving fund.

headings.title: Supreme court accounting rules and procedures
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes supreme court accounting guidelines, procedures, forms, controls, and discrepancy rules under sections 488.010 to 488.020; source notes "section 514.015" in original rolls.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on supreme court disbursement rules and trust funds, 30-day OSCA disbursement (80% general revenue / 20% counties and 60%/40% interest split), and accounting rules; corrected subsection 2 note and noted original-rolls footnote ("section 514.015").

headings.title: Statewide court automation surcharge assessment
headings.reviewNote: Imposes statewide court automation surcharge on civil and criminal cases.

headings.title: Transmission and deposit into court automation fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs clerk collection and disbursement under sections 488.010 to 488.020 payable to the director of revenue for the statewide court automation fund in section 476.055.

headings.title: Application to cases filed on or after statutory dates
headings.reviewNote: Specifies statutory dates governing implementation and case applicability for automation surcharge.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on the statewide court automation fee, remittance to the director of revenue for the section 476.055 fund, and applicability to cases filed on or after September 1, 1994; notes 2000 transfer from former section 476.053.

headings.title: Additional fee schedule for civil and criminal filings
headings.reviewNote: Sets embedded additional filing fee table for appellate ($20), circuit ($10), associate circuit ($8), and small claims ($0) actions, excluding non-alcohol traffic cases.

headings.title: Collection and disbursement of filing surcharges
headings.reviewNote: Directs clerk collection and payment to OSCA for the basic civil legal services fund, excluding dismissed criminal cases and waived or government-paid costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections including the embedded four-tier filing fee table (appellate $20, circuit $10, associate circuit $8, small claims $0; traffic exception) and remittance to OSCA for the basic civil legal services fund.

headings.title: Witness attendance fees and travel allowance
headings.reviewNote: Entitles witnesses to statutory attendance compensation and mileage under section 491.280.

headings.title: Examination of witness under oath regarding attendance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court or clerk to examine witness under oath regarding attendance and travel mileage.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections allowing witness fees under section 491.280 and authorizing examination of witnesses on oath by the court or ordered clerk.

headings.title: Judicial facility surcharge in thirty-first judicial circuit
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes up to $10 surcharge in criminal, ordinance, traffic, and infraction cases in the thirty-first judicial circuit (note: catchline says "Circuit No. 37") upon county or municipal authorization.

headings.title: Dedication of surcharge funds to court facility debt and costs
headings.reviewNote: Restricts surcharge revenue to judicial facility construction, maintenance, and debt service.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on the up-to-$10 criminal judicial facility surcharge in the thirty-first judicial circuit and dedicated facility uses; explicitly notes catchline ("Circuit No. 37") vs. body ("thirty-first judicial circuit") discrepancy and corrected civil-case error in draft note.

headings.title: Municipal ordinance violation surcharge in St. Louis City
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes municipal ordinance surcharge of up to twenty dollars in the City of St. Louis.

headings.title: Judicial waiver of surcharge for indigency
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes judge to waive municipal ordinance surcharge upon finding of defendant indigency.

headings.title: Clerk collection and monthly disbursement to city
headings.reviewNote: Directs clerk collection and disbursement of the additional court cost to the city at least monthly.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on St. Louis City's up-to-$20 municipal ordinance court cost, indigency waiver, and monthly clerk disbursement to the city; corrected subsection 3 title/note (no renovation restriction in text).

headings.title: Additional courthouse maintenance surcharge in St. Louis City
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes additional five-dollar courthouse maintenance surcharge on municipal ordinance violations.

headings.title: Indigency waiver of maintenance surcharge
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes judge to waive courthouse maintenance surcharge for indigent defendants.

headings.title: Monthly disbursement and courthouse maintenance account
headings.reviewNote: Directs monthly disbursement to city treasury dedicated to municipal court building maintenance.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on St. Louis City's up-to-$5 municipal ordinance court cost, indigency waiver, and monthly disbursement dedicated to municipal courthouse restoration, maintenance, upkeep, and bond security.

headings.title: Municipal ordinance court cost in Kansas City and Springfield
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes up to five dollars court cost on municipal ordinance violations in specified home rule cities.

headings.title: Indigency waiver of court cost
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes judicial waiver of municipal court cost where defendant is found indigent.

headings.title: Monthly disbursement for municipal court software and technology
headings.reviewNote: Directs monthly remittance dedicated to court software, technology, and hardware expenditures.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on up-to-$5 municipal ordinance court costs in qualifying home rule cities (Kansas City and Springfield population classes), indigency waiver, and monthly disbursement for court information/records management systems.

headings.title: Mental health and treatment court surcharge in Kansas City
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes surcharge of up to seven dollars on ordinance violations for treatment courts in Kansas City.

headings.title: Indigency waiver of treatment surcharge
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes judge to waive treatment court surcharge for indigent defendants.

headings.title: Monthly disbursement to mental health and treatment fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs monthly disbursement dedicated to mental health court and treatment services.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on Kansas City's up-to-$7 municipal ordinance court cost (excluding dismissed cases), indigency waiver, and monthly disbursement exclusively for special mental health and treatment courts (Effective 12-18-18).

headings.title: Courthouse maintenance surcharge in Kansas City
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes surcharge of up to five dollars on municipal ordinance cases for court facility maintenance.

headings.title: Indigency waiver of courthouse surcharge
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes judge to waive facility maintenance surcharge where defendant is indigent.

headings.title: Monthly disbursement into municipal court maintenance fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs monthly deposit into municipal treasury account dedicated to court facility maintenance.

headings.title: Statutory expiration date of August 28, 2026
headings.reviewNote: Specifies statutory expiration date of August 28, 2026, for facility maintenance surcharge.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all four subsections on Kansas City's up-to-$5 municipal ordinance court cost, indigency waiver, monthly disbursement for municipal courthouse restoration/maintenance/bonds, and statutory expiration on August 28, 2026.

headings.title: Municipal ordinance surcharge in City of Florissant
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes surcharge of up to ten dollars on ordinance violations in City of Florissant.

headings.title: Monthly disbursement into municipal court facility fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs monthly remittance dedicated to municipal court facilities and construction costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on the City of Florissant population-class up-to-$10 municipal ordinance court cost and monthly disbursement dedicated to municipal courthouse land, construction, maintenance, and bonds.

headings.title: Court reporter appeal transcript fee per legal page
headings.reviewNote: Sets court reporter compensation of three dollars and fifty cents per page for appeal transcripts.

headings.title: State payment of indigent criminal appeal transcript fees
headings.reviewNote: Requires state payment of two dollars and sixty cents per page for indigent criminal appeal transcripts.

headings.title: Judicial order for official court reporter transcript
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes judge to order evidentiary transcript for court use at two dollars and sixty cents per page.

headings.title: Definition and formatting standards for legal page
headings.reviewNote: Defines legal page requirements including margins, line spacing, and minimum twenty-five lines per page.

headings.title: State payment by voucher and requesting party responsibility
headings.reviewNote: Requires state payment upon court-approved voucher for subsection 2 and 3 transcripts, while all other transcript costs are borne by the requesting party.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all five subsections on court reporter transcript fees ($3.50/page appeal, $2.60/page indigent criminal or judge-ordered), 25-line legal page formatting, and state voucher vs. requesting-party payment; corrected subsection 5 title/note and noted 2000 transfer from former section 485.100.

headings.title: Judicial facility surcharge in Greene, Cass, and Jefferson counties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes judicial facility surcharge of ten dollars in specified circuit court counties.

headings.title: Restriction of surcharge proceeds to judicial facility costs
headings.reviewNote: Restricts expenditure of surcharge revenue to county judicial facilities and courtrooms.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on the $10 criminal judicial facility surcharge in Greene, Cass, and Jefferson County population classes and dedicated county judicial facility operating uses; notes 2000 transfer from former section 483.591.

headings.title: Family Services and Justice Fund and $30 family court surcharge
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Family Services and Justice Fund and imposes a $30 surcharge in family court proceedings, with chapter 455 petitioner, government, and waived-cost exemptions.

headings.title: Assessment of up to $30 judgment in juvenile proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Permits assessing a judgment up to $30 against a child, parent, or custodian in chapter 211 informal adjustments or disposition/treatment orders.

headings.title: Payment of collected sums to county family services funds
headings.reviewNote: Directs that all sums collected under this section and section 487.140 be payable to the various county family services and justice funds.

headings.title: Expenditures for mediation, counseling, and guardian ad litem services
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes expenditures for alternative dispute resolution, counseling, and child advocates.

headings.title: State reimbursement for additional family court commissioner salaries
headings.reviewNote: Requires circuits or counties appointing post-August 28, 1993 family court commissioners under sections 487.020 to 487.040 to reimburse the state for actual salary costs from retained fund moneys.

headings.title: Capital expenditure restriction on fund moneys
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits expenditure of fund moneys for capital improvements or facility construction.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all six subsections on the Family Services and Justice Fund, $30 family court surcharge, $30 juvenile judgment, fund deposits, enhanced services (no domestic-violence mediation), commissioner salary reimbursement, and capital-improvement ban; fixed mismatched draft headings/notes on subsections 2, 3, and 5 and noted cross-reference to section 488.429.

headings.title: Circuit clerk fees for statutory liens and record duties
headings.reviewNote: Specifies circuit clerk filing fees for mechanics' liens and statutory record entries.

headings.title: Garnishment surcharge for record maintenance and distribution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes ten-dollar surcharge on garnishments for clerk record maintenance and disbursement.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on circuit clerk fees for statutory lien duties under sections 429.090 and 429.120 and the permissive up-to-$10 garnishment surcharge for clerk case processing and record preservation (Effective 1-15-15).

headings.title: Juvenile justice preservation fund surcharge on civil filings
headings.reviewNote: Imposes three-dollar and fifty-cent surcharge on civil filings for juvenile justice preservation.

headings.title: Expiration condition tied to statutory fee expiration
headings.reviewNote: Ties expiration of this section to expiration of section 211.435(1); Revisor's note states S.B. 53 & 60 (2021) repealed the expiration date for section 211.435(1).

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on the $3.50 civil-action surcharge for the juvenile justice preservation fund and contingent expiration tied to section 211.435(1); notes 2021 Revisor's note that S.B. 53 & 60 repealed section 211.435(1)'s expiration date.

headings.title: Criminal offense fee schedule for statutory funds
headings.reviewNote: Imposes statutory fees on criminal convictions and guilty pleas for state and local funds.

headings.title: County judgment share of collected criminal recognizance forfeitures
headings.reviewNote: Entitles counties to a judgment of 25% on forfeited criminal recognizances up to $500 and 15% on sums over $500.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on criminal conviction/guilty-plea fees ($10 traffic/infraction, $25 misdemeanor, $75 felony) payable to county treasury and county judgment shares (25% up to $500; 15% over $500) on forfeited criminal recognizances.

headings.title: Law library surcharge authorized by circuit court en banc
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit judges en banc to impose surcharge of up to twenty dollars for law library.

headings.title: Continuation of prior surcharge and statutory fee caps
headings.reviewNote: Retains August 28, 2001 surcharge until changed and caps adjustments at $15 generally or $20 in Jackson County, St. Louis City, and family-commissioner-reimbursing circuits.

headings.title: Exemption for proceedings where costs are waived or paid by state
headings.reviewNote: Exempts cases where costs are waived for indigency or paid by state or political subdivisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on circuit court en banc civil filing surcharges, retention/modification caps ($15 generally; $20 in Jackson County, St. Louis City, or family-commissioner-reimbursing circuits), and waived/government-cost exemptions (A.L. 2026 S.B. 835 & 1111; formerly 514.440).

headings.title: Law library fund maintenance and administration
headings.reviewNote: Requires county treasury deposit and judicial administration of law library fund proceeds.

headings.title: Use of law library funds for family court services
headings.reviewNote: Permits expenditure of surplus law library funds for county family court services.

headings.title: Use of law library funds for courtroom renovation and technology
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes use of library funds for courtroom renovation, technology enhancement, and facilities.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on paying section 488.426 surcharges to circuit judges en banc or designated treasurer for law libraries, family services and justice funds, and courtroom renovation/technology enhancement (formerly 514.450).

headings.title: Sheriff civil service and mileage charges
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes sheriff charges and mileage rates for civil process service and execution of writs.

headings.title: Execution sale commissions, property storage costs, and mileage
headings.reviewNote: Sets sheriff commissions on execution sales (5% on $500, 4% above $500; half without levy/sale), party payment of seizure/storage costs, and courthouse mileage, excluding garnishment proceeds.

headings.title: Additional service charge for deputy salary and retirement funds
headings.reviewNote: Provides additional $20 (1st/2nd/4th/charter) or $15 (3rd class) service charges under section 57.280(4) remitted via county treasurer to state treasurer for deputy salary supplementation or sheriffs' retirement funds.

headings.title: Ten-dollar court cost for specially appointed process servers
headings.reviewNote: Requires clerk collection of $10 under section 57.280(5) when a non-sheriff is specially appointed to serve process in counties receiving section 57.278 funds, deposited into the deputy sheriff salary supplementation fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all four subsections on sheriff civil service/mileage fees, execution commissions and property storage costs, additional section 57.280(4) charges for deputy salary/retirement funds, and $10 special process server costs; replaced mismatched draft headings/notes on subsections 2–4 (A.L. 2025).

headings.title: County shelter for victims of domestic violence surcharge
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes county governing body to impose filing and marriage license surcharges for domestic shelters.

headings.title: Surcharge on marriage license issuance and civil filing actions
headings.reviewNote: Sets five-dollar marriage license fee and two-dollar civil filing surcharge for shelter fund.

headings.title: Monthly accounting and distribution to designated shelters
headings.reviewNote: Requires monthly accounting by recorder and clerk and disbursement to qualifying domestic shelters.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections authorizing county/St. Louis City $5 marriage license fees and $2 civil filing surcharges and monthly recorder reporting/deposit into a special fund for domestic violence shelters (formerly 455.205).

headings.title: Circuit court restoration surcharge in City of St. Louis
headings.reviewNote: Requires a $45 surcharge on civil cases filed in the circuit court of a city not within a county before summons issuance, excluding waived or government-paid costs.

headings.title: Deposit into municipal court restoration account
headings.reviewNote: Directs deposit into city treasury dedicated to historic court building restoration.

headings.title: Statutory expiration date of August 28, 2033
headings.reviewNote: Provides statutory expiration date of August 28, 2033, for court restoration surcharge.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on St. Louis City's $45 civil-case courthouse restoration surcharge, courthouse restoration fund/bond security, and August 28, 2033 expiration date (formerly 478.401); corrected civil-only scope in subsection 1 note.

headings.title: Customer damages and attorney fees for wrongful utility action
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes damages and reasonable attorney fees for a utility customer in default if the court finds the utility willfully and wrongfully instituted a meter access action under sections 393.550 to 393.565.

headings.title: Discretionary taxation of court costs in utility access disputes
headings.reviewNote: Governs discretionary taxation and apportionment of court costs between utility parties.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on customer damages and attorney fees when a utility willfully and wrongfully brings a meter access action and discretionary taxation of costs and sheriff expenses.

headings.title: Time-payment fee on unpaid court debts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes assessment of twenty-five dollar fee on court debt unpaid thirty days after judgment.

headings.title: Allocation of time-payment fee between circuit clerk and state
headings.reviewNote: Allocates $10 of the time-payment fee to the county court fund, $8 to the statewide court automation fund (section 476.055), and $7 to state general revenue.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on the permissive $25 time-payment fee for court-ordered debts unpaid after 30 days and its three-way allocation ($10 county court fund, $8 statewide court automation, $7 general revenue); fixed split in subsection 2 note.

headings.title: Inmate prisoner detainee security fund surcharge
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes two-dollar surcharge on municipal and criminal violations for inmate security.

headings.title: Clerk collection and monthly deposit with local treasurer
headings.reviewNote: Requires court clerks to collect surcharge and deposit proceeds monthly into security fund.

headings.title: Permitted expenditures for inmate security and biometric systems
headings.reviewNote: Restricts expenditures to jail security, biometric identification systems, and prisoner housing.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on the locally approved $2 criminal/ordinance/juvenile surcharge, clerk collection and disbursement to local treasurers, and Inmate Prisoner Detainee Security Fund uses with anti-supplanting protection.

headings.title: State income tax and lottery setoff for delinquent court debt
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes setoff against tax refunds and lottery winnings for unpaid court costs and fines.

headings.title: Debtor information provided to revenue and lottery commission
headings.reviewNote: Directs OSCA to furnish identifying debtor and debt information to the department of revenue and state lottery commission for tax refund and lottery setoffs.

headings.title: Department of revenue notification of tax refund intercept
headings.reviewNote: Requires revenue department to notify courts administrator of intercepted refunds and lottery prizes.

headings.title: Debtor notice and thirty-day window for review request
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice to debtor of proposed setoff and thirty-day period to seek court review.

headings.title: Transfer and distribution of intercepted tax refund proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Directs transfer of setoff funds to courts administrator for satisfaction of court debts.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all five subsections on state income tax refund and lottery prize setoffs for delinquent court and section 221.070 jail debts, OSCA/DOR/lottery notices, 30-day review/joint-return protections, and treasury escrow distribution.

headings.title: Conservation license suspension referral for delinquent jail debt
headings.reviewNote: Directs OSCA to notify the department of conservation of persons delinquent in county jail payments under section 221.070 after appeal expiration (source notes referenced "Subsection 6" does not exist).

headings.title: Coordination procedure between courts administrator and conservation department
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes data exchange and suspension procedures between court administrator and conservation.

headings.title: Pre-referral notice to debtor and dispute period
headings.reviewNote: Requires advance written notice to debtor with thirty days to challenge debt or request review.

headings.title: Circuit court judicial review of debt referral
headings.reviewNote: Provides procedure for debtor to obtain circuit court hearing on debt validity.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all four subsections on OSCA referral of delinquent section 221.070 county jail debtors to the department of conservation for hunting/fishing license suspension, cooperative procedures, debtor notice, and 30-day court review; notes source footnote that "Subsection 6" does not exist.

headings.title: DNA profiling fund surcharge on criminal convictions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes assessment of DNA profiling surcharge on felony and misdemeanor convictions.

headings.title: DNA surcharge amounts for felonies and other criminal cases
headings.reviewNote: Assesses $30 for felonies, $60 for chapter 579 class A/B/unclassified felonies, and $15 for other criminal cases except misdemeanor traffic violations (expires August 28, 2029 per subsection 5).

headings.title: Clerk collection and monthly transmittal to state treasurer
headings.reviewNote: Requires clerks to transmit DNA surcharge collections monthly to state treasurer.

headings.title: Deposit and administration of DNA Profiling Analysis Fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the non-reverting DNA Profiling Analysis Fund administered by the department of public safety for highway patrol crime lab DNA profiling under section 650.052.

headings.title: Statutory expiration date of August 28, 2029
headings.reviewNote: Provides statutory expiration date of August 28, 2029, for DNA profiling surcharge.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all five subsections on DNA Profiling Analysis Fund surcharges ($30 felony, $60 chapter 579 class A/B/unclassified felony, $15 other criminal cases except misdemeanor traffic), clerk transmittal, DPS-administered non-reverting fund, and August 28, 2029 expiration of subsections 1 and 2.

headings.title: Sheriff charges for criminal case services
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes schedule of charges for sheriff services rendered in criminal proceedings.

headings.title: Reimbursement to other county sheriffs for service of process
headings.reviewNote: Requires a sheriff receiving a subsection 1 charge to reimburse another county's or St. Louis City's sheriff $3 per document served and returned, up to the total charge received.

headings.title: Taxation of sheriff charges as court costs in criminal cases
headings.reviewNote: Directs taxing of sheriff service charges as costs in criminal cases.

headings.title: Mileage reimbursement for criminal transport services
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes mileage reimbursement for sheriff and guards transporting criminal prisoners.

headings.title: Creation and administration of the MODEX Fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes MODEX Fund in state treasury for Missouri data exchange system operations.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all five subsections on sheriff criminal service charges ($75 felony/contempt, $10 misdemeanor, $6 infraction) with violations-bureau split, $3 inter-county sheriff reimbursement, taxation as costs, IRS-rate mileage, and non-reverting MODEX Fund; corrected subsection 2 title/note.

headings.title: Peace officer standards and training commission surcharge
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes surcharge of up to two dollars for police training and one dollar for POST commission.

headings.title: Allocation of surcharge funds for local law enforcement training
headings.reviewNote: Restricts county and municipal proceeds to local law enforcement officer training.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on the locally authorized $2 law enforcement training surcharge, mandatory $1 POST commission fund surcharge, and local training expenditure rules with $1,500-per-officer retention cap (formerly 590.140).

headings.title: Crime victims' compensation fund surcharge in criminal cases
headings.reviewNote: Imposes seven-dollar and fifty-cent surcharge on criminal convictions for crime victims.

headings.title: Monthly collection and transmission to state treasury
headings.reviewNote: Directs clerks to remit collections monthly to state treasury for Crime Victims' Compensation Fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on the $7.50 Crime Victims' Compensation Fund surcharge in criminal, ordinance, and juvenile proceedings (excluding dismissed and government-paid cases) and clerk collection/disbursement under sections 488.010 to 488.020.
